hero.badge: AVAILABLE FOR DIGITAL PRODUCTS, PORTFOLIOS AND WEB SYSTEMS
hero.subtitle: I turn real-world problems into well-structured digital products, combining software engineering, thoughtful interfaces, and decisions designed for performance, maintainability, and growth.

about.title: I design and build digital products by bringing narrative, interface, and engineering together. Transforming complex problems into experiences that are clear, reliable, and built to evolve.
about.p1: I work across modern frontend, application architecture, mobile products, AI-powered systems and data-oriented platforms.
about.p2: My focus is software that feels polished to use, easy to understand and sustainable to evolve.
about.author: Vanderlei Vidor

music-player.cardDescription: Local-first player for personal libraries, resilient playback and a polished listening experience.
music-player.description: Explore the Music Player case study: a local-first Flutter player focused on owned libraries, resilient queue state, native controls and release discipline.

saas-data-control.cardDescription: Java/Spring task platform with secure sessions, user-scoped data and reports.
saas-data-control.description: Explore the SaaS Data Control case study: a productivity platform built around authentication, contextual data access and operational clarity.

english-tutor.cardDescription: Language tutor with a Teacher Brain, local LLM and pedagogy-led progression.
english-tutor.description: Explore the English Tutor case study: a Flutter/FastAPI experience where the pedagogical layer decides before the model writes the response.

portfolio-nexus.cardDescription: Case-study ecosystem with Next.js, i18n, SSG and modular engineering narrative.
portfolio-nexus.description: Explore the Portfolio Nexus case study: the portfolio itself as a presentation system with localized content and static routes for real projects.

stack.title: CAPABILITIES & STACK
stack.subtitle: Curated stack powering modern production applications.

process.intro: A working method for turning an idea into a product: clear context, thoughtful technical decisions, crafted interface work and validated delivery.

strategy.title: Context Before Code
strategy.description: The work starts by understanding goals, audience, constraints and risk. Before interface or architecture, I define the right problem so every decision has direction.
strategy.output: Brief, initial scope and product priorities

design.title: Experience That Explains
design.description: The interface is designed to guide, not only impress. Hierarchy, visual rhythm, responsiveness and accessibility help visitors understand value without friction.
design.output: Screen flow, visual narrative and base components

engineering.title: Sustainable Architecture
engineering.description: Implementation favors clear modules, type safety, structured content, predictable routes and components that can evolve without hidden coupling.
engineering.output: Modular technical base, integrated and ready to evolve

quality.title: Refinement Before Release
quality.description: Delivery goes through build, lint, type checking, navigation, responsiveness, public copy and interaction review to reduce friction in real use.
quality.output: Validated build, reviewed experience and clear next steps

contact.title: Let's turn an idea
contact.subtitle: If there is a product, portfolio, web system or app that needs more structure and clarity, we can start with a focused conversation.
